name: ALONE WhatsApp Bot
description: ALONE — futuristic multi-language WhatsApp bot (Baileys) by AKARSHANA

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner number, digits only with country code

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection string (Atlas free tier works). Stores sessions, settings, languages.

PAIR_NUMBER.description: Number to link as the MAIN session (use the owner's WhatsApp number for VIP features). The pairing code appears in the dyno logs.

ALLOW_PUBLIC_LINK.description: Let other people link their own WhatsApp with .connect

BANNER_URL.description: Optional — image URL shown on the main menu

MAX_FILM_MB.description: Max film size in MB sent as ONE WhatsApp document (WhatsApp limit is 2048)

FILM_QUALITY.description: Preferred max film height (360/480/720/1080). Auto steps down to fit.

FILM_CONCURRENCY.description: Films processed at the same time (1 is safest on a basic dyno)

YT_COOKIES.description: Optional — YouTube cookies as a JSON array (fixes bot-check on Heroku IPs)

YT_PROXY.description: Optional — proxy URL for YouTube downloads
